meta.agent: GEO AGENT A - Union Square plaza

coordinate_frame.description: Plaza-local frame. Origin = Dewey Monument axis. u = metres east along the Geary/Post direction (true bearing 80.9 deg, toward Stockton). v = metres north along the Powell/Stockton direction (bearing 350.9 deg, toward Post). Streets are rotated 9.1 deg counter-clockwise from true E/N. latlon = WGS84 [lat, lon].
coordinate_frame.source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API, fetched 2026-09-01 (ODbL) (monument node 11699339397; bearing from park polygon way 25278818)

meta.elevation_datum: NAVD88 metres from USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM; treat absolute values as +/-0.3 m, relative values as +/-0.2 m. Heights above Geary sidewalk are relative to the Geary mid-block sidewalk (19.9 m).
meta.confidence_legend: high = official/primary source or multiple agreeing sources; medium = single reliable source, OSM geometry, or DEM-derived; low = inferred from photos, undated blogs, or memory-level knowledge.

south_geary.summary: Highest retaining edge (3-4.7 m). Two corner entrance plazas with palms, two stepped lawn terraces (SW and SE lawns) facing north as amphitheatre seating, the garage vehicle portal at mid-block bridged by the plaza deck, long stair runs with landings flanking the lawns, then a planted band with benches and a 6-riser stair up to the central plaza.

changes_2025_2026.value: 2026: Powell Street Improvement Project (Market-Geary, $40M; 21 ft sidewalks, hanging lanterns, red brick roadway) - construction from late 2026, ribbon-cutting late 2027; does NOT touch the square's own Powell frontage

2026-08: SF Standard reports the square "back": busker program, toddler foam-block play area, ping-pong, chess tables with umbrellas, 500+ cameras and drone surveillance; new retail around the square (Zara flagship Post & Powell, Kith 100 Stockton, BAPE, Bang & Olufsen)
No capital renovation or "reimagining" of the plaza itself was found for 2025-2026; the 2002 Fotheringham/Philips layout is unchanged. Emporio Rulli and TIX are gone (2020 / 2019).
